matches.quote: The "exotic quantum phases" framing goes beyond the data. No magnetic measurement is presented... nor any evidence of flat-band or correlated behaviour.
The coincidence is more naturally explained by a common phase or region, for example stage-2 domains in the S4 crystal or a surface-bounding-layer contribution.
show the Hall data that the Methods say were measured, to confirm hole carriers and give a density for comparison with the frequency-derived density
Agreement is achieved only after a post hoc Fermi-level shift of about 0.1 eV, applied independently per structure. Even then the match is loose.
Air stability and sample homogeneity are not stated... add compositional analysis (EDX/WDS...)... add Raman spectroscopy... quantify the residual-graphite and mixed-stage fractions.
repeat at least the AB|AB and the four-layer structures with GGA+SOC+U in the zigzag (or ferromagnetic) state; report the resulting Dirac-point shift
state whether RuCl3-derived bands contribute Fermi-surface sheets, which would themselves produce SdH frequencies and should not simply be projected out.

notes: C5 is marked partly because the review asks about sample homogeneity, mixed-stage/residual-graphite fractions, RRR variability, Raman and EDX, but does not specifically mention crystal size, intercalation defects or local imaging (optical/STEM). C7 and C8 are marked partly because P7 challenges the same p. 5 claim about transferred electrons leaving alpha-RuCl3 insulating, asking how GGA+U+SOC and magnetic order affect the doped alpha-RuCl3 layers and whether RuCl3-derived states shift or contribute to the SdH frequencies, without framing this specifically around Cl-orbital localization. P12 discusses artificial DFT supercell strain rather than physical intercalation pressure/strain on Kitaev interactions (C6).
